facts.text: I changed my mind about the Tweet Full Column and want it limited to 280 characters including hashtags unless I specifically ask for an up to 4000 character version.
I want to remove the column altogether and make the tweet entry column be what was just described.
I want the key points of the tweets to both inform and increase engagement.
I want the tweets to be more specific about trivia per movie rather than a simple description.
I want the tweets to intersperse questions for the reader to respond to that are relevant.
